sample.question_description: Count the disks currently on a given peg.
sample.question_preview: Tower of Hanoi is a classic puzzle with three pegs labeled A, B and C (left to right) and several disks of different sizes. Disks are numbered by size: disk 1...
sample.question:
Tower of Hanoi is a classic puzzle with three pegs labeled A, B and C (left to right) and several disks of different sizes. Disks are numbered by size: disk 1 is the smallest. A disk's number is printed on it. Only the TOP disk of a peg can be moved, and it may only be placed on an empty peg or on top of a LARGER disk. The move X->Y means: take the top disk of peg X and put it on peg Y.

How many disks are currently on peg C? Answer with a single number.
sample.analysis:
Read the picture: peg A: disks [3, 2, 1] (bottom to top); peg B: empty; peg C: disks [4] (bottom to top).
Peg C holds disks [4], which is 1 disk(s).
So the answer is 1.

state_content.order: each peg lists disk sizes bottom to top; disk 1 is smallest
